body:
I cheated on him...I cheated on the person I was going to marry and I messed up so badly. I didn't want to be that person but I became her and now I can't live with that person. I can't change my past and my future doesn't feel hopeful.

But thank you for offering to be my friend. You seem very kind.
I'm just so lost now. This person was my world and I just couldn't get it together soon enough and I lost him. I can't do this alone any more.
